Referred to Commandant, S.V.C. for information.
（批：… C.S.P.）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
F. O. REG
No. 183
Date 21/3/16
17th March 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
The Chinese Authorities having received information that the rebels intended to start a rising within the next few days, extraordinary precautions are being taken in the City and Chapel.

Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕 鐵 生 , Head of the Anti-Yuan-Army in Shanghai, is at present on a visit to Sungkiang where he is said to be reorganising the rebel forces.

Four hundred and fifty troops with two machine guns left Woosung for Quinsan on 15th instant.

A young man of the student class was arrested in the vicinity of the Arsenal at 10 p.m. 15th instant. When searched, a map of the Arsenal and surrounding country was found in his possession.

It is reported that Kwangsi declared independence the day before yesterday.

It is said that the rebels in Shanghai have received $200,000 within the past few days.

It is strongly reported that a son of Yuan Shih Kai, but which one is not stated, visited the Arsenal within the past few days, but has now returned to the North. He is said to have been accompanied by one of Chiangchun Feng's officers.

Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
转交上海万国商团司令官知悉。
（批：… C.S.P.）
上海工部局。
F. O. REG
第 183 号
日期 1916年3月21日
1916年3月17日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

中国当局获悉叛军拟于数日内发动起义，故在上海县城及城隍庙地区正采取特别防范措施。

上海反袁军首领钮铁生目前正访问松江，据称他正在那里重组叛军部队。

四百五十名士兵携两挺机枪于本月15日离开吴淞前往昆山。

一名学生模样的青年于本月15日晚10时在兵工厂附近被捕。经搜查，发现其身上藏有兵工厂及周边地区的地图。

据报道，广西于前日宣布独立。

据悉，上海的叛军在过去几天内已收到20万美元。

有强烈消息称，袁世凯的一个儿子（未指明是哪一位）于近日访问了兵工厂，但现已返回北方。据说他由张作霖的一名军官陪同。

您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警察总监
